worked_solution:
Isolating the cubic term, we find

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2}\sqrt[3]{6x-2}+8 & <10 \\ \frac{1}{2}\sqrt[3]{6x-2} & <2 \\ \sqrt[3]{6x-2} & <4.\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we cube both sides and get

$$
\begin{aligned}{(\sqrt[3]{6x-2})}^{3} & <{4}^{3} \\ 6x-2 & <64 \\ 6x & <66 \\ x & <11.\end{aligned}
$$
